chapter: Silently the Butterfly Crosses the Valley
act_title: Silently the Butterfly Crosses the Valley

quests.title: Silently the Butterfly Crosses the Valley

dialogue.t: Sorry? What were you saying just now...?
Uh... Huh? Who art thou who disturb my beauty sleep...!
Eh!? Wh—Who's that?
Agh!
Waaaah!!!
Hahahahaha! Yes, yes! To fear me is only natural! Were I unconfined to this stone, you would already be in mine belly!
What...? Ah! So you're just a talking stone statue... Paimon thought you were a monster of some sort!
Hmph! What dost thou mean, "just a talking stone statue"!? Would not one such be frightening in itself?
Uh, we've come across many statues like you before, is the thing...
Wh—What!? *sigh* Fine. Seems like there's no scaring you guys...
Why must you do that, anyway? Sheesh! You're just a stone statue!
Hmph! Even if I was "just a stone statue," this place is still the Herblord's abode! When she was yet with us, she did not appreciate others disturbing her peace at their liberty!
And that's why I scare all the pesky ones away! I shall continue to do so even if she isn't around anymore!
Nevertheless, your presence does feel somewhat different from that of those ordinary mortals, and considering that I couldn't scare you either...
May I please ask you for a favor?
Huh? What can we help you with?
Ahem. Take a look at these colorful butterflies! Ever since the abode's lord departed, these little things have scattered all over the place, flying about as they please...
Shh... Hang on, there's one on your head! Just a moment. We'll help you get it...
Phew... Yes, just like that!

The abode's Herblord previously used these colorful butterflies to adorn its door, but said mechanism was later destroyed. These colorful butterflies and the medicine jar... were originally meant to nourish the adeptal tree.
Adeptal tree?
Heh, that's right! Back then, the Herblord planted this adeptal tree herself...
It may be withered now, but the Herblord said that so long as the colorful butterflies haven't all dispersed, the tree can be revived!
*sigh* She departed as soon as she lost the power to maintain her human form. I wonder how she's doing these days...

dialogue.sit: "As the vivid butterflies converge in the jar, new life shall be restored to the withered tree..."

dialogue.t: Yep, that's right! As long as... Wait, how did you know?
Never mind. Anyway, that's about it! As long as those colorful butterflies get put back into the jar, we can then nourish that withered tree! I'm counting on you, kind humans!
Phew... Yep, just like that!

The abode's Herblord previously used these colorful butterflies to adorn its door, but that mechanism was later destroyed. These colorful butterflies and the medicine jar were originally meant to nourish the adeptal tree.
Adeptal tree?
Heh, that's right! Back then, the Herblord planted this adeptal tree herself...
It may be withered now, but the Herblord said that so long as the colorful butterflies haven't all dispersed, the tree can be revived!
*sigh* She departed as soon as she lost the power to maintain her human form. I wonder how she's doing these days...

dialogue.sit: So what am I supposed to do?

dialogue.t: Ah, my apologies. I got a little carried away reminiscing about my lord...
Ahem! Listen carefully, humans! As long as those colorful butterflies get put back into the jar, we can then nourish the withered tree!
Heh, this is the adeptal mechanism designed by the Herblord. Pretty amazing, huh?

dialogue.sit: Let me give it a try.

dialogue.t: Sure thing. I'm counting on you then, kind humans!
Hmm...? Who art thou, to disturb mine... Ah, it's you, kind humans.
I leave the matter of the butterflies to you. I'm rather sleepy right now, so... *yawn* Don't mind me for a bit...

Hey! You liar! We've already returned all the colorful butterflies to the jar, but the adeptal tree still looks the same to Paimon!
Hmm...? Who art thou, to disturb mine... Ah, it's you, kind humans.
Ooh! I never thought you'd actually be able to find all the colorful butterflies! I just said that on a whim...
No, I meant... I felt the adeptal energies too! We just need to recite the formula that Herblord left us and we can revive the adeptal tree!
Hold on, how did that chant go again...?
"...Born in winter, thriving and withering through time. But I yearn for spring when beauty is regained..."
Butterflies flutter... flutter... Uh, I don't remember what comes next, but it ends with all being revived!
Whoa, it's changed completely!
Since the Herblord entrusted the tree to me, I couldn't stand to see it continue to wither! Thank you, kind humans!
You couldn't even remember the phrase at all!
Eh, don't sweat the small stuff!
Oh, if you're interested, I can give you a secret tip! Break off a branch and put it in the broken jar outside the abode, and the stone gate will open...
Zzz... Come now, pipe down, don't be so noisy...

quests.description: Yaodie Valley seems to conceal secrets unknown to all…
